row1.total_assets: JPMorgan Chase leads Total Assets at 4.4T USD, far ahead of Bank of America’s 3.4T USD. The gap between the top two banks exceeds 1T USD, while the next tier of tech giants (Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet) trails behind by more than 3T USD.

row1.operating_income_ebit: Apple leads with an operating income of 158.1B USD, outpacing Microsoft by 2.9B USD and NVIDIA by 27.7B USD, creating a clear top‑tier gap in EBIT among the five firms.
